editorNote: A Monday edition built from headline-level reporting, as article text was not retrievable: Duolingo and Rocket Lab company news, caution on Chinese stocks, gold and bitcoin in the shadow of oil and the Fed, and Alphabet earnings ahead. Nothing here is investment advice.

stories.headline: Duolingo reportedly trades some bookings for user growth, and Goldman Sachs lifts its price target to $135
stories.summary: A Pluang headline says Duolingo is reversing monetization moves, giving up about $50M in bookings to target 100M daily users by 2028, and a TipRanks headline says Goldman Sachs raised its price target to $135 from $114. Article text was not retrievable, so no further detail is given.
stories.whyItMatters: Per the headlines, the company's stated priority is shifting toward user growth over near-term bookings, and an analyst target moved up the same day.

sourceLinks.title: Duolingo reverses monetization to boost users, sacrificing $50M bookings to target 100M daily users by 2028 - Pluang
Duolingo price target raised to $135 from $114 at Goldman Sachs - TipRanks

stories.headline: Rocket Lab completes the US Space Force Victus Haze mission ahead of schedule, per Stocktwits
stories.summary: A Stocktwits headline says Rocket Lab finished the Victus Haze mission for the US Space Force ahead of schedule, with RKLB gaining after hours; an Investing.com headline says Cantor Fitzgerald reiterated its rating after the launch. Article text was not retrievable.
stories.whyItMatters: Per the headlines, a government mission wrapped early, giving the company a completed delivery to point to after a weak few weeks.
